title: Row build with a deleted work order, per row, or a row you can't start
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. Open the asset record (from a customer) and its Inspections tab.
  3. Seed: a Needs-action row whose run-on work order is deleted; an asset with several Needs-action rows; and a user who can fill inspections but cannot create work orders, on a row whose work order is closed.
custom_steps:
1. With the run-on work order deleted, confirm only the new-work-order target is offered.
2. Confirm each needs-action row is built separately — there is no bulk build.
3. As the fill-only user on a closed-work-order row, confirm the row shows a dash with an explanation that creating a work order requires 'Work orders - Create & Edit', readable on a phone with no hover.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • If the run-on work order has been deleted, only the new-work-order target is offered.
  • If several rows on the same asset need action, each is built separately; there is no bulk build.
  • A user who can fill inspections but cannot create work orders, on a row whose work order is closed, sees a dash with an explanation that creating a work order requires 'Work orders - Create & Edit', readable on a phone.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9104 (S6 — Build from the asset Inspections tab); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S6; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-E1: “If the work order the inspection was run on has been deleted, only the new-work-order target is offered”
  • S6-E2: “If several rows on the same asset need action, each is built separately. There is no bulk build”
  • S6-E3: “A user who can fill inspections but cannot create work orders, looking at a row whose work order is closed, has no available action. The row will show a dash with an explanation that creating a work order requires 'Work orders - Create & Edit'. The explanation must be readable on a phone, where there is no hover”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
